page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ic5.16xlarge is a compute-optimized instance hosted on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8163 processor providing 64 vCPUs across 32 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The configuration pairs these 64 vCPUs with 64.0 GB of memory, yielding a compute-heavy 1:1 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 1.0 GB per thread. The processor architecture includes 35 MB of L3 cache, along with support for vector processing instructions including AVX, AVX-512, and AVX-512 VNNI. The instance features no local storage, requiring network-attached storage, and provides a 20 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. No hardware accelerators or GPUs are included.

Benchmark evaluations indicate distinct performance patterns driven by the core count and single-thread capabilities. Single-core performance falls in the lower tiers, evidenced by a Geekbench single-core score of 1022.0 and lower throughput in single-threaded gzip compression. Conversely, multi-threaded workloads leverage the 64 virtual cores to achieve solid throughput, with multi-threaded bzip3 decompression reaching 205.34 GB/sec and a PassMark CPU score of 38537.29. Memory subsystems demonstrate balanced performance, handling large block uncached reads at 119.27 GB/sec and writes at 52.85 GB/sec.

With its dense CPU core count and restricted memory footprint, ecs.ic5.16xlarge is positioned for horizontally parallelized CPU-bound workloads where large memory caches are unnecessary. The instance is suited for batch processing, compilation tasks, multi-threaded scientific simulations, and distributed data processing pipelines that scale across many threads without exceeding 1 GB of memory per thread. Workloads requiring high per-core single-thread clock speeds, extensive in-memory databases, or onboard local NVMe disk arrays will encounter architecture limitations on this profile.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ic5.16xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance designed for parallel computing tasks that demand high core density rather than extensive memory. Built on the x86_64 architecture using an Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, the instance delivers 64 vCPUs across 32 physical cores with 64.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a 1:1 vCPU-to-memory allocation. Hardware acceleration includes AVX-512 vector extensions, paired with 20 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The instance includes no local storage or dedicated GPUs, relying on external network volumes. Benchmark metrics reflect modest single-threaded execution balanced by capable multi-threaded parallel throughput, recording a PassMark CPU score of 38537.29 and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression at 205.34 GB/sec. Given its lean memory capacity relative to core count, ecs.ic5.16xlarge is best suited for multi-threaded batch compute, distributed web serving, video transcoding, and scalable CI/CD build environments.
